profile.headline: Big Data / Analytics / ML / GenAI
profile.summary:
TL;DR - I like solving complex problems with elegant, generalized solutions and making where I work a better
place for me and my peers. I enjoy building highly effective, technology focused teams that
develop pioneering products. I'm an Agile evangelists and believe in communication
over process.

I am an experienced technologist, leader, and engineer with deep expertise in building software organizations across a range of business domains, each of which has been heavily focused on the value of data and the insights well-formed data can provide. I have spent over a decade in the big data space working with distributed technologies and creating value by delivering quality real-time products, matured technology direction and strategy. All of these experiences created a pathway that proceeded to my graduate education in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and inferential statistics to answer the question of “how can we improve given answers unknown?”

Professionally and academically I have done work in inferential statistics, AI, big data (Hadoop and Spark), predictive analytics, machine learning (NLP, classification, RNN for time series predictions, and reinforcement learning).  Prior to my Master’s degree at Georgia Tech I took courses at the University of Colorado that focused on pure symbolic AI and complex problem solving through knowledge decomposition and representation.  I’ve lead architecture, SDLC, and build foundational software for product to gain consistency and expedite delivery around complex distributed systems.  I have worked as an Agile mentor in several organizations and have strived to streamline process via automation and collaboration.  However, I will always enjoy being an IC as much as a leader.

Specialties: distributed systems/compute, machine learning, expert system development, algorithm development, data analytics (R, Python, Spark)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I currently lead many data and analytics initiatives in eero (an Amazon subsidiary).

positions.title: Senior Analytics Engineer / Cloud Reliablity Engineering
positions.description:
Oracle's hybrid cloud strategy for on-premise and cloud-native support requires constant real-time monitoring and predictive capabilities to maximize SLAs for infrastructure as well as service availability to internal users and customers.
* building scalable applications for data streams on Kubernetes to enable analytics efforts
* leveraging Apache Spark to do online analytics against streaming data 
* leading development efforts for data acquisition / ETL and architecture of associated strategies

positions.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
positions.description:
Oracle Cloud is in direct competition with Google and Amazon for foundational cloud platforms, PaaS solutions, cloud storage, and analytics.  Oracle Cloud Storage Analytics applies machine learning and data science methodologies to maximize efficiencies and minimize downtime and outages in Oracle Cloud Storage.
* overall architectural leadership of data acquisition strategies and big data architctures
* development of Apache Spark ETL data flows (batch and streaming) on Mesos leveraging Spark 2.x
* development of real-time streaming aggregations using Spark Structured Streaming, and statistical + ML-based anomaly detection methodologies
* serve in an advisory role for data architecture across functional units

positions.title: Principal Engineer, Adaptive Learning
positions.description:
Pearson Education is the world’s leader in education software consequently possessing the largest data sets in relation to learning experience and efficacy. DAALT’s (Data Analytics and Adaptive Learning Technologies) sole mandate is to establish the pace for data aggregation and real-time processing of educational date (event streams and contextual), and developing ML based predictive algorithms to improve education practice and efficacy.

* worked actively with the division’s Data Science team to identify strategies and practices to bridge the gap between discovery analytics and productionization of algorithms by leveraging Apache Spark
* developed graph traversal strategies and graph database implementations using both TitanDB graph database in a semantic and property based structure using TinkerPop Blueprints + Clojure
* developed semantic HTTP 1.1 query implementations leveraging RDF and OWL standards
* established the standard of peer review of software deliverables; versioning; documentation; build and release strategies
* developed streaming and batch processes on Apache Spark and Kafka for the processing of data to produce predictions via linear and logistic regression, and interstitial feature extraction for re-use in varying other statistical models
* designed and implemented foundational libraries for Java and Scala largely leveraging AOP (AspectJ) and currying strategies; supports metrics aggregation, transactions, REST bootstrapping
* designed and implemented a JVM focussed API Security framework that supports rate limiting, HMAC, PKI of symmetric keys, short-lived AccessTokens, ApiKeys and grant policies across systems 
* prototyped data-driven ETL strategies for the the functional transformation and schema validation of data leveraging Apache Camel
* prototyped strategies for the near real-time calculation and transformation of facts/messages based upon a relational algebra

positions.title: Director of Development
positions.description:
Mobile Accord is a mobile platform company powering communication for social good. Mobile Accord’s products and services empower major nonprofits, political organizations, universities, and governmental entities to benefit from the power of mobile technology. We offer the solutions and strategic expertise necessary to successfully implement scalable mobile solutions around the world.

•	Designed and implemented the core .NET foundation libraries all new development is currently building off of, as well as developed a roadmap for the maturation of legacy architectures
•	Developed cron-like scheduling system in .NET and CouchDB that exposes a standardized REST client library, callback structure, dynamic invocation operations.  
•	Designed and developed a Java based, distributed, NoSql driven messaging platform supporting many enterprise messaging protocols based upon a unified data model and mutli-faceted exposed REST API.  Leverages a high level of abstraction and templates to guarantee message state and lifecycle, allows for a high level of mock-ability.  Currently supports SMS, Parlay, and Twilio
•	Designed and developed a billing platform in .NET and CouchDB that is integrated with carriers and billing aggregators around the world.  Leverages heavily embedded templates and abstracts for quick implementation of new providers
•	Developed a Javascript code generation codebase in .NET that generates java script proxy “classes” from .NET driven annotated web services for HTML 5 applications

positions.title: Director, Development and Architecture
positions.description:
CNBC, Digital fulfills the technology strategy and development of all digital needs for CNBC.  While serving in this capacity with CNBC I:
* defined the SCM and ALM concerns including development, build and release strategies
* developed the core foundation libraries that the current CNBC APIs are built from
* led the Market Data team and was a key individual contributor to the current Market Quotes API
* led the Mobile development teams and was a key contributor to CNBC's presence in the Android and iOS market places
* built the foundation libraries for Android (mobile and iTV) and introduced AOP into the Android stack

In this role I coordinated large teams around the world in both a consulting and FTE fashion as well as defined strategy with large consulting agencies to ensure product delivery.


I currently lead the Core Services group for CNBC, Digital as well as lead a large number of SCM and ALM initiatives in the organization.  I largely work on platform and framework initiatives ranging from real time market data acquisition to distribution services.

positions.title: Director, Development and Architecture
positions.description:
Leader, thinker and technology visionary of a forward thinking, international mobile software development company.  Focused on developing distributed, real-time content delivery platforms and application frameworks for the mobile arena.  Leader of the 40+ person North American technology organization.

•	Drove standardization of technology, process and software development practice in the North American division as well as working to apply standards internationally in the various other Zed regions ultimately allowing for fluid development and international collaboration.  Focus on design practice, best practices, core library and framework development, SCM and ALM concerns
•	Introduced automation concepts including QA standardization of automation processes, ORM DAL generation and automated integration testing
•	Led integrated development initiatives with Tier 1 and 2 mobile carriers for the provisioning of content across mobile technologies (Web, Wap, BREW, Windows Mobile, Blackberry and Android)
•	Helped standardize international disaster recovery strategy by via SAN replication and server virtualization
•	Responsible for the operational and capital expenditures of the technology group as well as the training schedules for all employees
•	Responsible for the introduction of technologies and/or development strategies to improve the efficiency, productivity and quality output of the development teams

positions.title: Systems Architect and Mgr. Research and Development
Systems Architect
positions.description:
Development Leader and builder of a 20+ person software development group focusing on mobile application, mobile framework and content delivery platform development. 

•	Standardized the development practice and through the introduction of pure OO concepts and consistent use of design patterns and development of core, domain libraries
•	Introduced and standardized SDLC concerns around UML, design reviews and code reviews
•	Introduced MDD, IoC and SOA concepts to help create a highly extensible, available architecture with a grammatically sound domain specific language
•	Introduced and developed frameworks that allowed for the compartmentalization of pluggable domain concepts
•	Implemented various SCM concepts that helped to solidify isolation and repeatability in testing of systems development
•	Introduced Agile SCRUM development paradigm as well as helped to guide the processes of project management and product management leveraging Microsoft’s Team Foundation Server (TFS) using the Conchango SCRUM template
•	Introduced branch by feature branching strategy and leveraging the full power of TFS in relation to SDLC (e.g. work item changeset attachment, bug reporting, continuous integration and release candidate builds, automated unit testing)
•	Developed many enterprise, distributed product platforms to support the mobile arena on several Tier 1 and 2 carriers across many diverse mobile technologies (WAP, Mobile Web, Windows Mobile, Blackberry, BREW)
•	Developed a diverse and flexible content management system with scalable subsystems

positions.title: Senior Engineer, Data Acquisition Group
positions.description: Wall Street On Demand specializes in providing financial research to Fortune 500 customers and large brokerage houses via data aggregation techniques, warehousing techniques and in-house web development.  It manages large portions of the research sections for sites of the top on-line brokerage houses.  Its specialty is custom financial site integration as well as the creation of graphical research for individual investors.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Senior developer of a real time aberrance, overpayment healthcare claims adjudication system.  The system, Claimsguard, leveraged an ANSI common lisp engine, CLISP, for pattern detection using the Rete algorithm.   The system as whole was designed and implemented as a highly distributed, scalable system that can process claims sub-second with an extremely high accuracy in relation to the historical information of patients in the system and all procedures applied to them.
